title: ARWP AI Crawler & Access Matrix
scope: Officially documented crawler, fetcher and product-control surfaces relevant to AI search visibility, user-triggered retrieval and AI/model training decisions.

methodology.principle: Search/indexing, user-triggered retrieval and training are independent publisher decisions. Never collapse them into one AI-access flag.
methodology.rightsVsAccess: Content-license permission (for example ARWP CC BY 4.0 AI training permission) is separate from technical crawler access controlled by robots.txt, meta directives, WAF rules or product-specific controls.

entries.officialDescription: OpenAI documents OAI-SearchBot as the crawler publishers should allow for site content to be included in summaries and snippets in ChatGPT search.
entries.publisherEffect: Blocking it can prevent page content from being used in ChatGPT search summaries/snippets; allowing it does not guarantee inclusion or ranking.
entries.measurement: ChatGPT referral URLs include utm_source=chatgpt.com according to OpenAI's publisher FAQ.

entries.officialDescription: OpenAI tells publishers to disallow GPTBot on sites/pages they want excluded from potential model training.
entries.publisherEffect: GPTBot can be blocked independently from OAI-SearchBot, enabling ChatGPT search discovery while signaling training opt-out.

entries.officialDescription: ClaudeBot collects public web content that could potentially contribute to Anthropic model training.
entries.publisherEffect: Restricting ClaudeBot signals that future site material should be excluded from Anthropic AI-model training datasets.

entries.officialDescription: Claude-SearchBot navigates the web to improve search result relevance and accuracy for Claude users.
entries.publisherEffect: Blocking it prevents Anthropic from indexing the site's content for search optimization and may reduce visibility/accuracy in user search results.

entries.officialDescription: Claude-User retrieves web content when a Claude user asks a question that requires accessing a website.
entries.publisherEffect: Blocking it prevents user-initiated retrieval from the site and may reduce visibility in user-directed web search.

entries.officialDescription: Googlebot is the ordinary Search crawler. Google states that AI Overviews and AI Mode use the same Search crawling/indexing controls; there is no separate AI-search crawler requirement.
entries.publisherEffect: For Google Search AI features, pages must be eligible for ordinary Search crawling/indexing and snippets. Blocking Googlebot affects Search, including AI Search features.

entries.officialDescription: Google-Extended is a robots.txt product token, not a distinct HTTP user-agent. It controls whether Google-crawled content may be used to train future Gemini models and for grounding in specified Gemini/Vertex AI experiences.
entries.publisherEffect: Disallowing Google-Extended does not affect Google Search inclusion/ranking or Google Search AI features, but can restrict Gemini training and specified non-Search grounding uses.

entries.officialDescription: PerplexityBot indexes pages to surface and link websites in Perplexity search results and is not used to crawl content for AI foundation-model training.
entries.publisherEffect: Perplexity recommends allowing PerplexityBot for search visibility. Its July 2026 help center states PerplexityBot now crawls content in compliance with robots.txt.

entries.officialDescription: Perplexity crawler documentation describes Perplexity-User as a user-triggered fetcher and says it generally ignores robots.txt because the fetch is user-requested.
entries.publisherEffect: Do not infer a stable robots policy from one source: Perplexity's July 2026 help center says the prior ability to summarize explicitly blocked URLs was disabled, while the crawler documentation still describes Perplexity-User as generally ignoring robots.txt.
notes: ARWP leaves this robots behavior unresolved until Perplexity's official sources converge or a newer source clearly supersedes the crawler documentation.

entries.officialDescription: Bingbot is Bing's standard crawler for discovering and indexing web pages. Bing's search index powers Microsoft search and AI experiences including Copilot, while Bing Webmaster Tools now reports AI citations.
entries.publisherEffect: Allowing Bingbot supports Bing indexing and upstream AI/search citation opportunities. Microsoft documents separate robots meta/X-Robots-Tag controls for content display and generative-AI training; Bingbot itself is not a dedicated training crawler token.
